coso_tooltips.p1: Commitment to integrity and ethical values (Code of Conduct).
coso_tooltips.p2: Board of Directors demonstrates independence and exercises oversight.
coso_tooltips.p3: Management establishes structures, reporting lines, and authorities.
coso_tooltips.p4: Commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals.
coso_tooltips.p5: Individuals held accountable for their internal control responsibilities.
coso_tooltips.p6: Specifies objectives with sufficient clarity to identify risks.
coso_tooltips.p7: Identifies risks to the achievement of its objectives.
coso_tooltips.p8: Considers the potential for fraud in assessing risks.
coso_tooltips.p9: Identifies and assesses changes that could significantly impact controls.
coso_tooltips.p10: Selects and develops control activities to mitigate risks.
coso_tooltips.p11: Selects and develops general control activities over technology (ITGC).
coso_tooltips.p12: Deploys control activities through policies and procedures.
coso_tooltips.p13: Obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information.
coso_tooltips.p14: Internally communicates information to support internal control.
coso_tooltips.p15: Communicates with external parties regarding internal control.
coso_tooltips.p17: Evaluates and communicates internal control deficiencies.

warnings.unsaved_changes: There are changes that haven't been synced to Matrix. Close this popup anyway?
warnings.delete_risk_confirm: WARNING: Deleting this risk will remove ALL control data under it. This data will be PERMANENTLY deleted from the RCM database when you click 'Save & Sync'. Continue?
warnings.delete_control_confirm: Delete this Risk-Control mapping row? Data related to this row will be permanently lost from the TLC Matrix after synchronization.
warnings.hard_delete_notice: ATTENTION: Clicking save will PERMANENTLY delete Risk/Control data that you have removed from this popup in the database.

domains.access: Control over the provision of access rights to the IT environment (applications, databases, operating systems, networks, and tools) only to authorized users.
domains.development: Control to ensure that every system/application development/acquisition has at least gone through a request, development/acquisition, testing, and implementation process approved by all authorized parties.
domains.changes: Control to ensure that every change to systems/applications, data, and related infrastructure components has at least gone through a request, testing, and implementation process approved by all authorized parties.
domains.operations: Control to ensure that systems/applications process data completely and accurately, and ensure that identified incidents and problems are resolved completely and accurately.
